day_local: Xuska Our Lady of the Rosary
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto, adinkoo maanta isugu yimid inaynu Rabbiga ku ammaanno baryo iyo dhageysiga ereygiisa.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: U baxa dunida oo dhan, oo sheega Warka Wanaagsan.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kaceyso oo aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay tahay mid qabow oo qoto dheer, adigoo fiirinaya booska uu Benjamin Vo mar walba fadhiisan jiray, adigoo xusuusanaya tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee wiilkaaga. Maanta, adigoo jooga meeshan, waxaan eegaynaa qolka uu Benjamin ku qaatay saacadihiisa aamusnaanta, halkaas oo ay ku yaalliin buugaagtiisa teknoolojiyadda, kombuyuutarradiisa, iyo sawirrada diyaaradaha uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya akhriyin buugaagta, laakiin dhisayey fikirkiisa ku saabsan nolosha. Halkaas ayaynu ka billaabaynaa maanta, annagoo aan degdegeyn, annagoo si dhab ah u eegaya noloshaas quruxda badan ee uu Ilaahay inoo dhiibay mudada kooban.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'gacanta la is-dhiibay'. Akhriska koowaad, Bawlos wuxuu ka hadlayaa markii ay tiirarka kaniisadda, James, Cephas, iyo John, ay gacanta u dhiibeen isaga iyo Barnabas 'si ay u wada shaqeeyaan'. Waa calaamad kalsooni, waa ballan ah inaan cidna kaligeed socon. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo bixiyo gacantiisa. Xusuusnow markii uu ahaa shan iyo toban jirka, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil gacantiisa iyo qalbigiisaba u dhiibay dadka uu jeclaa.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay ahaayeen kuwo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira waqtiyo habeenkii ah oo ay codadka gurigu aamusaan, oo ay xusuustaadu kusoo dhacdo dhoola-caddayntii Ben markii uu ku oran jiray 'Good morning, Dad.' Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkaan si tartiib ah u joojino oo aan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskooda ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Waxaad siiseen Ben jacayl aan xad lahayn, waalidnimadiinuna waxay ahayd hadiyad uu Ben ku koray.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, xertii ayaa weydiisay Ciise: 'Rabbiyow, na bar sida loo baryo.' Ciise wuxuu baray 'Aabbahayaga'. Waa baryo nagu xiraysa Aabbaha jannada. Ben, markii uu ku jiray safarradiisii adduunka, laga bilaabo Lourdes ilaa Vatican-ka, wuxuu bartay inuu gacantiisa u dhiibo Ilaah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu gacantiisa ku jiraa gacanta Aabbaha. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Haddaad gacantiinna ii dhiibteen, ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waan ku jeclahay wax kasta, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kugu soo dhoweeyo. Maadaama aanan hadda si dhab ah kuu qaadan karin, fadlan naftayda kula midoow ruux ahaan. Ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu dhiibeynaa Ben iyo dhammaan inta naga horreysay, inuu iftiinkaaga weligiis u iftiimo, nabadna ay ku nastaan.
Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu dhiibeynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan waalidka iyo walaalka Ben, si aad qalbigooda u dejiso, rajo cusubna aad ugu beerato.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, afar iyo toban sano ka dib, waxaan mar kale u kacay Yeruusaalem anigoo la socda Barnabas, waxaana kaxaystay Titus. Waxaan u kacay si waafaqsan muujin, waxaana u bandhigay iyaga Injiilka aan ku wacdiyo dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn—laakiin si gaar ah ayaan ula hadlay kuwa la ixtiraamo—si aanan u noqon mid si aan micne lahayn u ordaya, ama u orday. Taas beddelkeeda, markay arkeen in laygu aaminay Injiilka dadka aan gudan, sida Butrus loogu aaminay kuwa gudan, waayo kii Butrus ka dhex shaqeynayay si uu u noqdo rasuul u ah kuwa gudan, ayaa sidoo kale igu dhex shaqeynayay si aan u noqdo rasuul u ah dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn. Markay aqoonsadeen nimcada lay siiyay, James iyo Cephas iyo John, oo loo haystay inay yihiin tiirar, waxay i siiyeen aniga iyo Barnabas gacmahooda midig si aan u wada shaqeyno, inaan anagu u tagno dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn, iyaguna ay u tagaan kuwa gudan. Waxa kaliya ee ay nagu yiraahdeen waa inaan xusuusnaanno masaakiinta, taas oo ahayd waxa aan aad u doonayay inaan sameeyo. Laakiin markii Cephas yimid Antioch, waxaan u diiday wejigiisa sababtoo ah wuxuu ahaa mid cad oo qaldan. Waayo, ilaa ay dad ka yimaadeen xagga James, wuxuu cuni jiray dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn; laakiin markay yimaadeen, wuxuu bilaabay inuu dib u gurto oo uu kala gooni noqdo, sababtoo ah wuxuu ka baqay kuwa gudan. Yuhuuddii kalena waxay u dhaqmeen si munaafaqnimo ah isaga la jir, taas oo keentay in xataa Barnabas uu la qaado munaafaqnimadooda. Laakiin markaan arkay inaysan ku socon waddada saxda ah ee waafaqsan runta Injiilka, waxaan ku iri Cephas hortooda oo dhan, 'Haddii aad tahay Yuhuudi, aadna u nooshahay sida dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn oo aadan u noolayn sida Yuhuudda, sidee baad dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ugu qasbi kartaa inay u noolaadaan sida Yuhuudda?'

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. U baxa dunida oo dhan, oo sheega Warka Wanaagsan. Ammaana Rabbiga, idinkoo quruumo dhan, weyneeya isaga, idinkoo dad oo dhan! R. U baxa dunida oo dhan, oo sheega Warka Wanaagsan. Waayo, naxariistiisu waa mid adag oo inoo haysa, daacadnimada Rabbiguna way sii waari doontaa weligeed. R. U baxa dunida oo dhan, oo sheega Warka Wanaagsan.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise ayaa meel ku tukanayay, markuu dhammeeyayna, mid ka mid ah xertiisii ayaa ku yiri, 'Rabbiyow, na bar sida loo baryo, sida Yooxanaa u baray xertiisa.' Wuxuu ku yiri iyaga, 'Markaad tukanaysaan, dheh: Aabbe, magacaagu ha quduusnaado, boqortooyadaadu ha timaado. Na sii maalin kasta kibisteenna maalinlaha ah, oo noo cafiyay dembiyadeenna, waayo anaguna waxaan u cafinaa qof kasta oo nagu leh dayn, hana noo kaxayn imtixaanka ugu dambeeya.'

day: Memorial of Our Lady of the Rosary

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
